# Code of Conduct

We are committed to a respectful, welcoming community. Treat people with
respect, assume good intent, and keep feedback constructive. Harassment,
discrimination, intimidation, and personal attacks are not acceptable.

Project discussions and contributions should stay focused on the work. Follow
the repository's contribution and security-reporting guidance, and do not post
private information or vulnerability details in public issues.

Report conduct concerns through [GitHub's abuse reporting process](https://github.com/contact/report-abuse).

This policy follows the principles of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
